name: readable-helper-urls
goal: Readable helper paths retain callable identity, branch, revision, tabs and backward-compatible deep links

evidence: Replace module-id and query helper links with readable helper-name paths and path tabs; qualify duplicate names, preserve branch/commit and old links.
Existing route roundtrip and callable-detail matrices require query selectors and never assert readable addresses, alias ambiguity or direct refresh. Strengthen those shared cases.
